rmt-2013-calc-02.prompt: Compute all real values of $b$ such that, for $f(x)=x^2+bx-17$, $f(4)=f'(4)$.

rmt-2013-calc-03.prompt: Suppose $a$ and $b$ are real numbers such that $$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin^2x}{e^{ax}-bx-1}=\frac12.$$ Determine all possible ordered pairs $(a,b)$.

rmt-2013-calc-07.prompt:
The function $f(x)$ has the property that, for some real positive constant $C$, the expression $\dfrac{f^{(n)}(x)}{n+x+C}$ is independent of $n$ for all nonnegative integers $n$, provided that $n+x+C\ne0$. Given that $f'(0)=1$ and $\displaystyle\int_0^1f(x)\,dx=C+(e-2)$, determine the value of $C$.

(Note: $f^{(n)}(x)$ is the $n$-th derivative of $f$, and $f^{(0)}(x)=f(x)$.)

rmt-2013-calc-08.prompt: The function $f(x)$ is defined for all $x\ge0$ and is always nonnegative. It has the additional property that if any line is drawn from the origin with any positive slope $m$, it intersects the graph $y=f(x)$ at precisely one point, which is $\frac1{\sqrt m}$ units from the origin. Suppose further that $f$ has a unique maximum value at some real number $x=a$. Find $\displaystyle\int_0^af(x)\,dx$.
